INDUSTRIAL DESIGN STUDIODIRECTED BYGIOVANNI FILARDI

We transform technical constraints and human intuition into physical products prepared for industrial reality.

Project-built capabilities are assembled around each programme. One design direction remains accountable through development and production review.

[ STUDIO MODEL //PROJECT-BUILT CAPABILITIES ]

DIRECTED BYGIOVANNI FILARDI.BUILT AROUNDTHE PRODUCT.ONE DESIGNDIRECTION.

OPERATING MODEL // 01—04

Giovanni Filardi Design is an industrial design studio directed by Giovanni Filardi. Each programme is structured around the product rather than a fixed agency model, combining GFD design direction with the client’s internal capabilities and selected specialists where required.

We work with founders, design directors and R&D teams when a product must become clearer, more distinctive and ready for manufacture.

From new products to active developments requiring resolution, one accountable design direction aligns design, engineering, suppliers and manufacturing decisions.

01 / 04

Lead

Establishes product architecture, design logic and development priorities before form becomes fixed.

DIRECTION/DEFINITION
02 / 04

Integrate

Works inside the client’s design, R&D and engineering functions, aligning decisions without adding another layer of distance.

CLIENT/R&D/ENGINEERING
03 / 04

Extend

Introduces only the specialist expertise required by the programme, from CMF and prototyping to technical and manufacturing support.

SPECIALIST/DEFINED BY SCOPE
04 / 04

Carry

Protects the approved direction through CAD refinement, prototypes, design-for-manufacture and production review.

PROTOTYPE/TRANSFER/REVIEW
[ MATERIAL DECISIONS //RESEARCH DEFINED FOR EACH PROGRAMME ]

MATERIALS ARE NOT FINISHES. THEY ARE SYSTEM DECISIONS.

Material decisions are investigated within each programme through performance, process, tooling, recycled content, repairability, disassembly and recovery.

Where required, the studio works with suppliers, manufacturers and specialist partners to evaluate alternatives against the technical, commercial and production reality of the product. Research is defined for each programme and activated only where it can materially improve performance, lifespan or production logic.

PERFORMANCE PROCESS TOOLING LIFESPAN RECOVERY
M / 01

Recycled Polymers

Industrial and consumer recovered feedstocks are assessed against surface quality, mechanical performance, process stability and repeatability.

M / 02

Metals with Reduced Impact

Material grades, recycled content, section efficiency, finishing processes and recoverability considered as one manufacturing decision.

M / 03

Biological and Renewable Composites

Natural fibre and biologically derived systems are evaluated only where performance, ageing and production logic are credible for the intended use.

M / 04

Single Material Architecture

Reduced material families, fewer interfaces and clearer separation strategies simplify manufacture, recycling and long term maintenance.

M / 05

Repair & Disassembly

Fasteners, access, replaceable components and reversible assemblies are studied to extend useful life before recovery is considered.

LESS MATERIAL.
LONGER LIFE.
CLEARER RECOVERY.
